# oref0 algorithm subset

Source: https://github.com/openaps/oref0, npm release 0.7.1.
Four unmodified MIT-licensed files are retained: determine-basal, basal-set-temp,
round-basal, and the insulin action-curve calculator. LICENSE.txt accompanies them.
Only lodash/endsWith is needed. The package's legacy command-line/network/native
dependencies are not included. This is a reference controller for synthetic
research, not a certified AAPS replacement or clinical dosing service.
